name: Blister
description: A blister beetle, in the Gland's slot by turns, and the one shooter on the pan that comes inside your reach. Seen from above, facing +x: a soft blood-red abdomen with four pale coral glands swelling along its sides — what the fan is made of — under two coal elytra held permanently open in a V, because it is already spraying; a small coal pronotum, a dark head with mandibles, long antennae. Red-and-black, the warning colours the real animal wears, and nothing else on the pan is red. `ss.enemy.droplet` is what it throws, four at a time. No `elite` variant: a squad body is never marked. Mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 10. The `death` clip flares the elytra fully open and bursts the four glands outward.

scurry.description: a quick tripod scurry with the body pumping forward on the step, the held-open elytra fluttering, antennae whipping and the glands along the sides swelling

death.description: the elytra flare all the way open, the four glands along the sides burst outward and vanish, the body deflates between them, the legs fold in and the organ goes out
